fresh_actual_checks: Both complete unfiltered streams, all current input identities, all G public/original/accepted changes and complete control pointers independently checked.
Formal/caller/evidence bytes and modes match the reviewed candidate; pending G records retain control qualification and no accepting/closing side effect.
Fresh current ACT contract text comparison of WP58 §3/§5.2, WP41 §4.2, WP49 §3/§5.1, WP50 §5.2 and WP55 §2.3. These define the same legal entry, return and cancellation boundaries after integration.

entry_requirements.requirement: Per-member speed order, item then ability, first true stops
entry_requirements.reason: WP58 row114 matches WP49 line45: per battler item then ability, not one global items pass then another global abilities pass. False/cancel alone does not stop a first-true scan.

entry_requirements.requirement: Real event, effective effect, trainer/owner/candidate and exit guards
entry_requirements.reason: Actual stat drop/effective EJECTPACK and strict integer half crossing/effective exit ability, own SkyDrop/opponent-live/leave/healthy-non-egg-same-owner-off-field reserve gates retained. Arbitrary HP loss/stat change does not trigger immediate selection.

entry_requirements.requirement: Opening snapshot and choice before first command, same playback consumer
entry_requirements.reason: Initial attributes precede normal start; legal entry can append index1 while roundindex=-1 and rounds=[]; playback entry consumes switches[0]=1 from cursor0 to1 before first command, no random or live selector. This is a stored unexecuted symbolic design.

entry_requirements.requirement: Attack action restriction cannot prevent upcoming first command
entry_requirements.reason: WP58 separates attack no-further-action from clearing old choice at opening. Replacement remains subject to ordinary later command guards; no unconditional action promise.

entry_requirements.requirement: Consumption, negative selection and replacement remain separate
entry_requirements.reason: EJECTPACK is consumed before query; -1 appended, handler false, no replacement and no item rollback. Exit-ability negative query similarly no replacement, no corresponding item consumption.

entry_requirements.requirement: EOR leave now, select at later replacement consumer
entry_requirements.reason: EOR returns true after recall/leave and defers query/append to later actual replacement; no immediate EOR-handler append is inferred.

entry_requirements.requirement: Scope2 exact synchronization and unchanged neighbors
entry_requirements.reason: Original WP58 endpoint equals exact grant, outside §5.2 byte-exact; W16/W24/W25, random forced switches and Arena candidate=false retained. B09/B11 original/formal writes remain unauthorized and unchanged.
